query ($search: bytea, $originChains: [Int!], $destinationChains: [Int!], $startTime: timestamp, $endTime: timestamp) @cached(ttl: 5) {
    q0: message_view(
    
    where: {
      _and: [
        {send_occurred_at: {_is_null: false}},

  msg_id

    confirmations: 0,
    where: {
      _and: [
        {send_occurred_at: {_is_null: false}},
        {is_provisional: {_eq: true}},
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
      ]
